# CLI reference

`pulsebench` drives everything the console does, from a shell or CI. In the Docker stack it is on the console container's PATH (`make console-shell`, or `docker compose exec console pulsebench ...`). `realy` is a legacy alias of the same command.

## `pulsebench abort`

Abort runs wherever they execute. Two channels: a Redis flag (seen within ~1 s by the run's lease heartbeat) and a bench.control message; either alone is enough.

```
pulsebench abort RUN_IDS [OPTIONS]
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RUN_IDS` | argument, optional |  | run ids to abort (any process: console, CLI, bench Job) |
| `--all` | flag |  | abort the pipeline's lease holder and every run listening on bench.control |
| `--console` | str |  | console URL: also cancel its queue and pause its schedules (with --all) |
| `--reason` | str | `aborted by operator (cli)` |  |

## `pulsebench control`

Publish a live control message on bench.control.

```
pulsebench control TARGET [OPTIONS]
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TARGET` | argument |  | gateway \| model \| emitter \| flink \| * |
| `--run-id` | str |  | run id the change applies to |
| `--tps` | float |  | emitter: new absolute TPS |
| `--scoring` | str |  | ScoringConfig proto3 JSON / YAML |
| `--model-server` | str |  | ModelServerConfig proto3 JSON / YAML |
| `--kafka-ingress, --no-kafka-ingress` | flag |  | gateway: enable/disable Kafka ingress |
| `--abort, --no-abort` | flag |  | abort the run |

## `pulsebench deploy-model`

Hot-swap the mock model server's weights (no restart): retrain -> redeploy -> measure.

```
pulsebench deploy-model WEIGHTS
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `WEIGHTS` | argument |  | proxy weights JSON (e.g. /models/proxy/versions/<version>.weights.json) |

## `pulsebench gate`

Fail a run that regressed: verdict, loss, verify, and p99 / knee / detection / CPU-per-event vs a baseline.

```
pulsebench gate RUN [OPTIONS]
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RUN` | argument |  | candidate run dir / id |
| `--baseline` | str |  | baseline run dir / id, or a baseline JSON (baselines/<scenario>.json) |
| `--save-baseline` | path |  | write RUN as a baseline file here and exit |
| `--p99-regress` | float | `0.1` | max relative p99 increase |
| `--min-delta-ms` | float | `5.0` | ...and only beyond this many ms (noise floor) |
| `--within-drop` | float | `0.01` | max drop of the share of events within budget |
| `--knee-drop` | float | `0.1` | max relative drop of the knee TPS |
| `--recall-drop` | float | `0.02` |  |
| `--precision-drop` | float | `0.05` |  |
| `--fpr-rise` | float | `0.01` |  |
| `--cpu-regress` | float | `0.15` | max CPU/event increase |
| `--max-duplicates` | int |  |  |
| `--require-verify, --no-require-verify` | flag |  |  |
| `--json` | flag |  |  |

## `pulsebench live-test`

Live acceptance suite against a running stack, through the console API: launch, steer, report accuracy (vs the ClickHouse audit), abort in every phase and from every process, bulk control, guardrails, dead instrument processes, signals and recovery. Exit 0 only if every check passes.

```
pulsebench live-test ACTION ARGS [OPTIONS]
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ACTION` | argument, optional |  | run \| fault-start \| fault-check |
| `ARGS` | argument, optional |  | fault-check: JOB_ID RUN_ID |
| `--console` | str | `http://localhost:8090` |  |
| `--case` | list[str] |  | run only these cases (repeatable); default: all |
| `--expect` | str | `zero-loss` | fault-check: zero-loss \| aborted \| interrupted |
| `--duration` | float | `90` | fault-start: run duration (s) |
| `--out` | path |  | write results JSON here |

## `pulsebench rules-whatif`

Replay rule sets / thresholds over a finished run offline: precision, recall, FPR, step-ups and their outcomes, $ approved per variant and per rule, against the run's own policy. Tune on a training run, confirm on the evaluation run.

```
pulsebench rules-whatif RUN_DIR [OPTIONS]
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RUN_DIR` | argument |  | finished run (served features + scores + ground truth) |
| `--rules` | list[path] |  | candidate rule set YAML (repeatable) |
| `--review` | float |  | override the review threshold for every variant |
| `--decline` | float |  | override the decline threshold for every variant |
| `--challenge` | float |  | override the step-up (CHALLENGE) threshold for every variant |
| `--sample-mod` | int | `1` | evaluate events with id % N == 0 only (speed) |
| `--model` | list[path] |  | also re-score the served vectors with these proxy weights (repeatable): model comparison on identical traffic |
| `--json` | flag |  |  |

## `pulsebench run`

Run a scenario end to end and write runs/<run_id>/report.{json,md,html}.

```
pulsebench run SCENARIO [OPTIONS]
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SCENARIO` | argument |  | scenario name (scenarios/<name>.yaml) or path |
| `--set` | list[str] |  | override, e.g. --set traffic.profile.tps=2000 |
| `--collectors` | int |  | collector processes (default: 1 per 15k TPS) |
| `--run-id` | str |  |  |
| `--wait-lease` | float |  | seconds to wait when another run holds the pipeline lease |
| `--verify` | flag |  | verify exactly afterwards (starts from fresh feature state when the warm state holds other runs' events) |

## `pulsebench size`

Capacity plan on GKE (+L4) for a target load, from measured per-event costs or documented assumptions.

```
pulsebench size [OPTIONS]
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--tps` | float | `10000` | steady-state events/s |
| `--peak` | float | `2.0` | peak factor: the plan is sized for tps x peak |
| `--headroom` | float | `0.55` | target utilisation of CPU-bound components |
| `--from` | str |  | run dir / id whose measured costs replace the assumptions |
| `--zones` | int | `3` | zones (N+1 and rack-aware Kafka placement) |
| `--customers` | int | `10000000` | active customers (state + online-store memory) |
| `--retention-days` | int | `30` | ClickHouse audit retention |
| `--set` | list[str] |  | override a cost, e.g. --set flink_cpu_ms=0.8 |
| `--json` | flag |  |  |
| `--write-overlay` | path |  | write a kustomize overlay (on top of overlays/gke-l4) here |

## `pulsebench train`

Train structural proxy models (MLP->ONNX/Triton + weights JSON, XGBoost->Triton FIL) on served features.

```
pulsebench train [OPTIONS]
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--run` | list[path] |  | finished run dir(s) to train on (served features + labels) |
| `--hidden` | str | `64,32` | MLP hidden layer sizes |
| `--trees` | int | `300` |  |
| `--depth` | int | `6` |  |
| `--input-dim` | int |  | pad the tensor to the production model width (0 = schema size) |
| `--labels` | str | `observed` | observed: labels as known at training time (delayed, unreported fraud missing, friendly fraud included) \| ground-truth: the generator's truth |
| `--label-maturity-days` | float | `30.0` | observed labels: train this many days after the last event |
| `--deploy, --no-deploy` | flag |  | hot-deploy the new MLP to the mock model server afterwards |
